name: Follow a goal, not every branch at once

pages.text: The quest book contains both essential progression and side projects. A food collection, a new spell or a more convenient storage room can be worth doing without being your next technological milestone.

When you feel pulled in too many directions, choose one goal: “I want my first steam machine,” “I need a renewable rubber supply,” or “I want better tool materials.” Work backwards from that goal and finish the supporting steps.
